newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ahmsa says postpones share issue.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ahmsa says postpones share issue.

text.p: Mexican steel-maker Altos Hornos SA (Ahmsa) will postpone its planned share offer until next year due to unfavorable steel market conditions, a company official said.

"We think we will come to market next year. We don't have any plans to come out this year particularly because of the international steel market conditions," Guillermo Ancira Elizondo, the head of Ahmsa's carbon division, told reporters at an energy conference here.
Ahmsa officials had said the company would place 70 million shares this year and an additional 55 million next year.
"Investors are likely to keep to the sidelines on an offer like this until international conditions improve," he said.
